body.purpose: Compact interface copy, controls, and panel headings.

shadows.name: modal-separation
shadows.purpose: Separate modal content from the workspace.

shadows.name: selected-clip
shadows.purpose: Make the selected timeline clip easy to identify.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Quick feedback for hover, focus, and pressed control states.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Teal primary action for creating a project or exporting a video.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-accent); color: #071719; font: 560 13px/1 "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 120ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Workspace Panel
components.description: Flat graphite work panel separated by a fine divider.
components.css: .ds-workspace-panel { padding: 16px; background: var(--color-panel); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-soft); color: var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Project List Row
components.description: Flat project row with a real thumbnail and concise edit metadata.
components.css: .ds-project-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line-soft); } .ds-project-open { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); text-align: left; font: inherit; } .ds-project-thumb { width: 120px; height: 68px; flex: none; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-panel-2); object-fit: cover; } .ds-project-name { min-width: 0; flex: 1; font-size: 13px; } .ds-project-date, .ds-project-format, .ds-project-duration { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 11px; } .ds-project-delete { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex: none; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-dim); } .ds-project-row:hover .ds-project-name { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-project-open:focus-visible, .ds-project-delete:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: LibreCut is a working tool, not a campaign surface. The home screen is a direct route into an edit, and the editor reserves visual priority for the footage and timeline. Graphite surfaces, fine dividers, and a single teal action color keep the interface legible without decorative noise.
keyCharacteristics: Media, preview, inspector, and timeline visible together
Teal for actions, keyboard focus, and selection
Local project status and export in the top bar
Flat project rows; no promotional hero or decorative gradient
LC monogram with a single-color wordmark

rules.name: The Teal Means Action Rule
rules.body: Use teal for primary actions, keyboard focus, and current selection. Track colors identify track kinds.

dos: Keep the preview and timeline as the visual center of editing.
Keep import, save, and export feedback clear.
donts: Do not imply CapCut or ByteDance affiliation.
Do not add cloud, account, template, or effect-store claims unsupported by the product.
